methods.label: Bisection update
methods.explanation: For a continuous function on a bracket \([a,b]\) with \(f(a)f(b)<0\), evaluate the midpoint \(m=(a+b)/2\). If \(f(m)=0\), the root has been found and the method stops. Otherwise, retain \([a,m]\) if \(f(a)f(m)<0\), or \([m,b]\) if \(f(m)f(b)<0\). The intermediate value theorem guarantees a root in the retained half.
